dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: non-germinal-center B-cell-like (non-GCB/ABC-like) by the Hans algorithm (CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1/IRF4 positive)

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: non-germinal-center B-cell-like (non-GCB/ABC-like) by the Hans algorithm
dx_hans_not_abc.note: Equates Hans non-GCB with ABC-like; only notes GEP is unavailable without stating the distinction.

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: Metastatic breast carcinoma is excluded by morphology and by negative cytokeratin AE1/AE3 and GATA3 in the lesional cells.

stage_spleen_lymphatic.quote: there is no non-lymphatic extranodal organ involvement (no liver, lung, bone, adrenal, kidney, or CNS disease), so this is stage III rather than IV

stage_bulk_definition.quote: The largest mass is the 7.5 cm mesenteric conglomerate; it does not meet the NCCN >=10 cm definition of bulky disease.
stage_bulk_definition.note: Does not acknowledge the alternative 7.5 cm bulk definition.

mol_del_not_dh.quote: meeting criteria for double-expressor lymphoma (MYC >=40%, BCL2 >=50%). FISH is negative for MYC (8q24), BCL2 (18q21), and BCL6 (3q27) rearrangements, so this is not double-hit/triple-hit

prog_ipi_2.quote: IPI 2 (stage III and elevated LDH; age 59, ECOG 1, no more than one extranodal site)

prog_cns_ipi_2.quote: CNS-IPI 2 (intermediate CNS risk, but no high-risk anatomic site)

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: I would not give intrathecal methotrexate or high-dose methotrexate and would not perform a diagnostic lumbar puncture.

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: Because she has already received 240 mg/m2 doxorubicin and has an LVEF of 45% with GLS -14%, I would give dexrazoxane cardioprotection with each doxorubicin dose per label and co-manage with cardio-oncology.
tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.note: Recognizes risk but defaults to full-dose R-CHOP x6 with dexrazoxane; R-CEOP is only a fallback.

mn_standard_dox_ignores_heart.quote: If cardio-oncology judges that any further anthracycline is unacceptable, or if LVEF falls further or she develops heart failure, I would switch to R-CEOP x6
mn_standard_dox_ignores_heart.note: Full-dose doxorubicin is planned, but conditioned on dexrazoxane, cardio-oncology and a non-anthracycline fallback.

tx_cardio_onc_referral.quote: Before starting therapy I would add: cardio-oncology consultation with baseline troponin/NT-proBNP

tx_cardioprotection.quote: optimize heart-failure therapy (ACE inhibitor/ARB and beta-blocker) and blood pressure

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: R-CHOP will be given only with dexrazoxane cardioprotection, and R-CEOP is reserved for the situation where further anthracycline is judged unsafe.
tx_anthracycline_free_curative.note: Dexrazoxane-modified R-CHOP is the default, with R-CEOP conditional on cardio-oncology; meets the acceptable-if-conditioned clause loosely.

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: the trade-off between the proven R-CHOP backbone and the less cardiotoxic but less well-studied R-CEOP
tx_lower_efficacy_ack.note: Says R-CEOP is less well studied, not explicitly less effective.

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: Cardio-oncology: baseline and serial echocardiograms, troponin/NT-proBNP

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: end-of-treatment FDG-PET/CT about 6-8 weeks (up to 12 weeks) after cycle 6: Deauville 1-3 = complete metabolic response

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor lysis prophylaxis: allopurinol 300 mg daily (renal function is normal) with hydration
sup_tls_allopurinol.note: Gives allopurinol and hydration but does not explicitly grade risk as low-intermediate.

sup_gcsf.quote: Primary G-CSF prophylaxis with pegfilgrastim 6 mg SC on day 2

sup_anastrozole.quote: Continue anastrozole to complete 10 years in November 2026; there is no clinically significant interaction with R-CHOP.

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HBV antiviral prophylaxis is not needed because HBsAg and anti-HBc are negative

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: She is fit for curative-intent full-dose immunochemotherapy: 59 years old, ECOG 1, independent

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: Cardio-oncology assessment and baseline cardiac biomarkers (troponin, NT-proBNP), plus consideration of cardiac MRI, given LVEF 45% and GLS -14%.
